run_primary_node: run a primary Narwhal node with keys, committee, store, and parameters config
run_worker_node: run a Narwhal worker node with keys, committee, store, parameters, and worker id
run_benchmark_client: run a benchmark client against a node address with specified message size and rate
generate_keys: generate cryptographic keys for a Narwhal node with a specified filename
compile_narwhal: compile the Narwhal Rust project in release mode with benchmark features enabled
